menu_tab_reset: Puts this tab's settings back to the defaults.
menu_empty: No mod has added a page.
menu_failed: This page failed to open. See the log.
profiler_needs_launcher: The Script Profiler needs a newer Obsidian Launcher.
profiler_about_ms: ms: the time the scripts of a mod take each frame, on average. FPS cost: the frames a second the game would gain without that time.
profiler_about_detail: Detailed adds the slowest frame of the last half second, the calls a frame, and the total of all scripts. Measuring runs only while the panel is not hidden.
profiler_about_log: While the panel is not hidden, a report goes to the log of Obsidian API every %s seconds, with the hooks and parts each mod spends its time in.
bridge_running: Memory Bridge: running code from a developer tool.
bridge_on_notice: The Memory Bridge is on. Galactic War and leaderboard results of this launch aren't sent.
